note: Block shapes (prefabs). The ids and names are the game's prefab type enum (plugins/docs/RealmSculptor.md cites it); ids 10-14, 16 (doors, gates, windows) and 255 (a multi-block part) are never used by sculptures. Each material lists its own shapes in the game's scene data, so the plugin checks that a material has the shape before placing it and falls back to a plain block. 'kind' is the geometry the tools ASSUME for rotation 0 (see shapes.mjs); every kind is UNVERIFIED until the shape-test sculpture has been looked at in game. 'fit' says whether the shape fitter may use it. Only the cube and the ramp are switched on.
